mapper.sql: id, agent_type AS agentType, tenant_id AS tenantId, people_id AS peopleId, staff_id AS staffId, org_id AS orgId, title, status, is_deleted AS isDeleted, gmt_created AS gmtCreated, gmt_modified AS gmtModified
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_session WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_session SET gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE agent_session SET status = 'CLOSED', gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE agent_session SET status = 'ACTIVE', gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE agent_session SET title = #{title}, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
